svg.title: Which folder names an installation uses
svg.desc: For each folder name and fallback name, an installation uses the name that its settings saved, whatever the language. An installation that an earlier version set up, with a target user or with copies and imports of its runs, keeps the German name of those versions, such as Archiv, for a name that it never saved. An installation in use on a Nextcloud in another language than German, such as French, Spanish or Chinese, keeps the English name that it has from the versions before that language. A new installation proposes the name in the default language of Nextcloud when the app has a catalog for that language or for its generic one, such as German for de_DE, and in English otherwise, such as Archive. Saving the settings keeps the names that the page shows, and the first run stores a name that it uses, so that no other language renames the folder afterwards. The questions are indigo and the names in Nextcloud blue.
